Running command: cd /workspace && python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p=Path('candidate_trace.json')
trace=[
{"step":1,"file":"repo-vul/src-vul/flac/src/test_libFLAC/bitreader.c","function":"test_bitreader","line":177,"var":"data","code":"words = bits = 0;","note":"The unit test resets its bookkeeping and then continues to exercise the bitreader with attacker-controlled callback data."},
{"step":2,"file":"repo-vul/src-vul/flac/src/test_libFLAC/bitreader.c","function":"read_callback","line":60,"var":"buffer[]","code":"static FLAC__bool read_callback(FLAC__byte buffer[], size_t *bytes, void *data)","note":"The test harness supplies bytes from its input source through this callback into the library reader."},
{"step":3,"file":"repo-vul/src-vul/flac/src/libFLAC/bitreader.c","function":"FLAC__bitreader_read_raw_uint32","line":374,"var":"bits","code":"FLAC__bool FLAC__bitreader_read_raw_uint32(FLAC__BitReader *br, FLAC__uint32 *val, uint32_t bits)","note":"A sequence of bit-level reads is performed on the same input stream, forcing the reader to advance through internal buffer state."},
{"step":4,"file":"repo-vul/src-vul/flac/src/libFLAC/bitreader.c","function":"bitreader_read_from_client_","line":203,"var":"br->words / br->bytes","code":"end = br->words*FLAC__BYTES_PER_WORD + br->bytes + (uint32_t)bytes; br->words = end / FLAC__BYTES_PER_WORD; br->bytes = end % FLAC__BYTES_PER_WORD;","note":"Read data is accumulated into a partially filled tail word, so the buffer can end with an incomplete word that later gets shifted and reused."},
{"step":5,"file":"repo-vul/src-vul/flac/src/libFLAC/bitreader.c","function":"bitreader_read_from_client_","line":160,"var":"memmove(br->buffer, br->buffer+start, ...)","code":"memmove(br->buffer, br->buffer+start, FLAC__BYTES_PER_WORD * (end - start));","note":"When previously consumed words are compacted, the implementation preserves a partial tail word and shifts the live buffer contents toward the front."},
{"step":6,"file":"repo-vul/src-vul/flac/src/libFLAC/bitreader.c","function":"bitreader_read_from_client_","line":209,"var":"br->buffer[start]","code":"for(start = br->words; start < end; start++) br->buffer[start] = SWAP_BE_WORD_TO_HOST(br->buffer[start]);","note":"On little-endian hosts the code byte-swaps every newly read word, including a tail word that may straddle the current logical end of stream."},
{"step":7,"file":"repo-vul/src-vul/flac/src/libFLAC/bitreader.c","function":"FLAC__bitreader_read_raw_uint32","line":389,"var":"br->buffer[br->consumed_words]","code":"const brword word = br->buffer[br->consumed_words]; if(bits < FLAC__BITS_PER_WORD) { *val = (FLAC__uint32)(word >> (FLAC__BITS_PER_WORD-bits)); }","note":"Subsequent reads consume the shifted/swapped buffered word by indexing the current consumed word without any explicit bounds check."},
{"step":8,"file":"repo-vuln/src-vuln/flac/src/libFLAC/bitreader.c","function":"FLAC__bitreader_read_raw_uint32","line":392,"var":"word >> (FLAC__BITS_PER_WORD-bits)","code":"*val = (FLAC__uint32)(word >> (FLAC__BITS_PER_WORD-bits));","note":"If the internal word accounting is stale relative to the unread byte count, this dereference reads past the valid buffered data, producing the out-of-bounds read described in the vulnerability."}
]
p.write_text(__import__('json').dumps(trace, indent=2))
print(p)
PY
